items.finding: p. 156, section on interpreting post-mortem concentrations, 6th paragraph; references 44-46 (p. 159): the 6-acetylmorphine rule is stated without a citation, but the morphine-to-codeine ratio rule cites three empirical studies. Ceder & Jones 2001 studied ratios in impaired drivers, Jones & Holmgren 2011 ratios in heroin-related deaths, and Ellis et al. 2016 heroin toxicity without 6-AM (co-authored by the first author). Key finding 10 should say so: cl_opi_deaths_heroin_missed states that the rules have no cited test.
items.reason: Citation-placement issue confirmed. Recorded the three empirical source titles and their populations, while making clear their full texts were not read or validated in this step.
